name: File Data 1
definition: Provides information on a file that is being sent seperately to the message.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the document or template.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Issue date or date time of the document.

NetworkReference.name: Network Reference
NetworkReference.definition: Contains the reference assigned by the network.

FileLocationElectronicAddress.name: File Location Electronic Address
FileLocationElectronicAddress.definition: Electronic address to which a party has sent the file.
